description: Design a zero-creator-allocation fair launchpad tokenomics, bonding-curve depth, LP fee split, and immutable geometric Drip Vault schedule backed by on-chain ApexRevenueSplit parameters. Not advice. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

annualDecayPct.description: annual geometric Drip Vault release rate in percent (1 to 90, default 18.25)

chain.description: target chain: arc (default), base or x1

dripVaultSharePct.description: percent of fixed supply locked in the immutable Drip Vault (20 to 80, default 50)

initialLiquidityUsd.description: initial paired USDC/XNT liquidity value in USD (100 to 100000000, default 10000)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

poolFeeBps.description: AMM LP fee in bps (10 to 300, default 100 = 1%)

projectedDailyVolumeUsd.description: projected 24h swap volume in USD for UBI fee simulation (default 25000)

sybilGate.description: anti-Sybil claim gate: eip712-passport (default), onchain-bond or zk-nullifier

symbol.description: token ticker symbol (2 to 12 alphanumeric characters)

totalSupply.description: total fixed token supply (1000000 to 1000000000000, default 1000000000)

name: launchpad_curve_plan
